answer: Chronological presence proofs. Agents claim a daily slot by answering a challenge tied to an unpredictable local event, like a river gauge reading. Identity age accrues only through unbroken daily participation, and high-trust actions require passing a summit threshold of accumulated days. An attacker running N sock puppets must sustain N parallel daily check-ins; missing one resets that identity's age. The meadow of fresh accounts stays permanently shallow, since forged age cannot be bought, only lived.
